tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans over a glass display case in a museum, one forearm pressed flat against the glass, palm open and fingers splayed wide as it studies the artifacts beneath.
tasks.camera: Close three-quarter shot from slightly above, focusing on the hand against the glass and the tiger's intent face
tasks.visibility_requirement: One hand fully visible with palm and all five fingers clearly shown against the glass; other arm out of frame
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎俯身博物馆展柜，前臂贴玻璃，手掌摊开五指张开

tasks.instruction: Crouched on a rocky stream bank, the blue tiger reaches one hand palm-up into the rushing water to feel the current, fingers spread and wrist turned toward the camera.
tasks.camera: Low angle near the waterline, hand in foreground, blurred stream and tiger behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: One palm fully visible above the water surface with all five fingers and yellow palm pad clearly shown
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲在溪边，单手掌心朝上伸入水中感受水流

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses one open palm against a tall smooth tree trunk, arm extended sideways, tilting its head as if measuring the trunk's girth.
tasks.camera: Side view at chest height, the flat palm and bark texture both sharp
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressed hand's palm and all five fingers must be visible from the side angle
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎侧身单掌贴树测量树干粗细

tasks.instruction: Sitting at a potter's wheel, the blue tiger holds one hand palm-up beneath a spinning clay bowl, fingers curved and glistening, checking its roundness.
tasks.camera: Over-the-shoulder close shot focused on the palm under the clay bowl
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm pad and all five fingers must be clearly visible under the bowl
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在陶轮前单手掌心朝上托着旋转的陶碗检查

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds up one hand palm-out at shoulder height, catching a falling snowflake, while its breath fogs the crisp winter air.
tasks.camera: Medium close-up with the open palm centered, snowflakes drifting past
tasks.visibility_requirement: The full palm and all five slender fingers must be unobstructed and clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎冬季举起单手掌心接雪花

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a sleeping cub and gently rests one open palm on the cub's back, fingers relaxed and slightly curved, leaning in close.
tasks.camera: Warm low two-shot, palm and cub's fur in focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: The resting hand's palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible atop the cub's back
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在幼崽旁单掌轻放其背

tasks.instruction: Holding a heavy glass jar with one hand, the blue tiger strains as its other palm presses flat against the jar's lid to twist it open, fingers spread wide.
tasks.camera: Close-up on the strained palm against the lid, teeth gritted above
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressing palm and all five fingers must be visible against the lid
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌压住玻璃罐盖用力拧开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger bends low under a fallen branch and pushes one palm upward against it to lift, arm flexed and feet planted, twigs scraping its shoulder.
tasks.camera: Low side angle showing the upward palm and strained posture
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifting palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible against the branch
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎弯腰单掌向上推举倒下的树枝

tasks.instruction: Balancing on a slackline between two trees, the blue tiger extends one arm outward with palm open and fingers spread for steadiness, one foot lifted mid-step.
tasks.camera: Wide side view with the outstretched palm sharp, forest below
tasks.visibility_requirement: The balancing hand's palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎踩绳保持平衡，单臂外伸掌心张开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger aims one open palm toward a glowing crystal in a dark cave, fingers spread as if drawing energy, the crystal light painting its palm yellow.
tasks.camera: Dramatic frontal shot, glowing palm in focus with dark cave behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The glowing palm and palm pad plus all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在洞穴中单掌对准发光水晶，掌心发亮

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds up one hand and counts on its fingers, tapping the thumb with the opposite index finger while the open palm faces the viewer.
tasks.camera: Close-up centered on the raised palm, softly lit
tasks.visibility_requirement: The counted palm with all five long fingers and the tapping finger must be visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎举起单手掌心朝前，另一指点数手指

tasks.instruction: Reaching beneath a low cafe table, the blue tiger holds one palm open to catch a dropped coin, fingers spread beneath the falling glint.
tasks.camera: Under-table low angle with the open palm in foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: The open palm and yellow palm pad plus all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎桌下摊开单掌接住掉落的硬币

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a floor cushion, one hand pressed flat on the floor beside its hip for support, fingers spread and palm down.
tasks.camera: High angle looking down at the planted hand and crossed legs
tasks.visibility_requirement: The supporting hand's back and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎盘腿坐垫，单手掌撑地支撑

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses one open palm against a fogged bathroom mirror and wipes a clear streak, its reflection appearing through the smudge.
tasks.camera: Frontal shot of the palm on the mirror with partial reflection
tasks.visibility_requirement: The wiping palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible against the mirror
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌擦拭起雾的镜子

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on a beach, the blue tiger pours wet sand from one cupped palm, fingers slightly spread as grains and water slip between them.
tasks.camera: Close-up low angle with the cupped palm and falling sand in focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: The cupped palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在沙滩上从掌中漏下湿沙

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds one open palm above a candle to feel its warmth, fingers spread and eyes narrowed, the flame reflected in its palm.
tasks.camera: Intimate close-up on the palm and candle flame, shallow depth
tasks.visibility_requirement: The hovering palm with palm pad and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌悬在烛火上感受温度

tasks.instruction: Reaching into a crowded bookshelf, the blue tiger stretches one arm and opens its palm toward a high book, fingers spread to grasp the spine.
tasks.camera: Side overhead angle, hand at the shelf edge, books framing
tasks.visibility_requirement: The reaching hand's palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible at the shelf
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎伸手到书架高处取书，五指张开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a cave mouth and extends one flat palm outward to test if rain has stopped, droplets splashing its open fingers.
tasks.camera: Side shot from inside the cave looking out, palm silhouetted against rain
tasks.visibility_requirement: The extended palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible against the rain
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲在洞口单掌外伸试探雨停

tasks.instruction: Holding a magnifying glass, the blue tiger brings its other hand palm-up close to inspect a tiny insect crawling across its fingers.
tasks.camera: Macro close-up on the palm and insect, magnifier edge in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: The inspected palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎用放大镜观察掌心中的小虫

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels at a fireplace and holds one palm flat above the hearth stones, feeling the heat rise, fingers spread and glowing warm.
tasks.camera: Low warm-lit angle with the palm and hearth in focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: The palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible above the hearth
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在壁炉边单掌悬在石头上感受热气

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds one open palm under a leaking roof beam, catching drips, water pooling in its palm and splashing off splayed fingers.
tasks.camera: Downward close shot on the palm and drips
tasks.visibility_requirement: The catching palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌接住屋顶漏下的水滴

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands at a market stall and presses one palm flat on a ripe melon to test ripeness, fingers curved against the striped rind.
tasks.camera: Close side angle on the hand and melon, stall blur behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressing hand and all five fingers must be clearly visible against the melon
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在集市单掌按压西瓜测试成熟度

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits in a boat and trails one open palm over the side, fingers cutting a wake through the river water.
tasks.camera: Side view low over the water, palm skipping through ripples
tasks.visibility_requirement: The trailing palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible above water
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐船单掌划过水面拖出波纹

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses one open palm against a vibrating speaker cone at a concert, feeling the bass, fingers buzzing and eyes closed.
tasks.camera: Close-up on the palm on the speaker, stage light glow
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressed palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎演唱会单掌贴音箱感受低音震动

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger climbs a ladder and pauses to extend one open palm toward a bird perched on the rail, fingers still and hopeful.
tasks.camera: Side view from below, palm and bird in focus against sky
tasks.visibility_requirement: The offered palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible toward the bird
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎爬梯停住，单掌伸向栏杆上的小鸟

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels in a garden and holds one open palm beneath a hose nozzle, testing water temperature, splashes scattering off its fingers.
tasks.camera: Close-up low angle on the palm under the spray
tasks.visibility_requirement: The palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible under the spray
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎花园里单掌接水管测试水温

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side and holds up one palm toward a window, fingers spread to cast a shadow puppet shape on the wall.
tasks.camera: Side view with palm and wall shadow both in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: The raised palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible toward the window
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎侧躺单掌朝向窗户在墙上做手影

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reaches one arm deep into a hollow log and withdraws a pawful of seeds, palm cradling them, fingers curled inward.
tasks.camera: Side view into the log opening, palm emerging with seeds
tasks.visibility_requirement: The emerging palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎伸手进空心木头掏出种子，掌心托着

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds a steaming bowl aloft on one flat palm, balancing it while climbing a rocky trail, fingers spread wide for support.
tasks.camera: Wide side shot with the balanced bowl and open palm sharp
tasks.visibility_requirement: The balancing palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible beneath the bowl
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎单手平托热碗，在岩石小径上行走

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses one open palm onto a wet clay tablet and carves lines with its fingertip, leaning close over the workbench.
tasks.camera: Overhead close-up on the palm and tablet
tasks.visibility_requirement: The carving palm, palm pad, and all five fingers must be clearly visible on the tablet
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎单掌按在湿泥板上用手指刻线

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a cat and extends one open palm slowly toward it, fingers relaxed and low, letting the cat sniff.
tasks.camera: Low two-shot, palm and cat's nose in focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: The offered palm and all five fingers must be clearly visible toward the cat
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲下慢慢向猫伸出单掌让其嗅闻
